rv.q: It’s a smart, timely, and timeless script that is both illuminating and alarming.
Heroes of the Fourth Turning will keep you thinking about the difficult questions asked and facts revealed long after leaving the theater.

cn.t: Arbery's Pulitzer-nominated drama earns strong praise, with critics recommending this award-winning exploration of ideology and conflict that sparked acclaim in its 2019 debut and continues to resonate in this production.
